Native: passes the ISP prefix through, which changes on every reconnection; devices keep stale addresses and that can break Matter (Google/Alexa).

Roteador: cria a própria rede e faz a co: Router: creates its own network and makes the internet connection. Wireless repeater: extends an existing Wi-Fi network. Calcula a interferência de cada canal do: Computes the interference of each 2.4 GHz channel (1 to 11) from the neighbouring networks, drops the ones that overlap the Zigbee channel and keeps the width at 20 MHz — at 40 MHz the Wi-Fi would cover Zigbee again. Unlike Xiaomi's optimization, it shows every channel. Applying with the width on automatic does a full save (restarts the Wi-Fi ~30 s); with a fixed 20 MHz the switch takes ~5 s.
